req_desc: The product serves a public marketing surface plus a governed console behind one sign-in ...
An `owner` administers members, groups, grants, policies, resources, environments ...
Sign-in accepts an email plus a password, returning a bearer token carrying the principal email, the principal role ...
The app list returned to a principal contains only apps that principal may open ...
Creating a resource takes a name, a kind, a host, a port, a database, a username, a password ...
Query parameters are bound by the driver, never pasted into the statement text ...
The editor holds four regions: a component tree, a canvas, a query panel, an inspector ...
Every component exposes the own state of that component under the component name ...
Grid paging, sorting, filtering, searching, aggregation execute at the resource ...
Two environments exist in promotion order: `staging`, then `production` ...
A permission action is one of `read`, `write`, `execute`, `publish`, `promote`, `administer`, `export` ...
An invitation message reaches the invited address alone, with no cc, with no bcc ...
The audit store is append-only for every principal in the product ...
The home route carries a hero, a feature block, a value block, a results band, two industry blocks, a closing composer, article cards, a footer ...
Typing an at-sign in the composer opens a source picker filtering as the visitor types ...
The demo form asks for a work email, a reason chosen from three declared options, nothing further ...
Search opens as an overlay from a header control, from a keyboard shortcut working on any route ...
An address resolving to nothing serves the not-found route with the full header, the full footer ...
An unauthenticated request for a console address lands on the sign-in route with the requested address remembered ...
The public surface renders dark on every route, declaring a dark colour scheme, carrying no light version ...
Every horizontal dimension on the public surface derives from one column arithmetic rule ...
The backend runs NestJS on Node 20, serving the JSON API ...
All timestamps are UTC ...
A single workspace exists, with no second tenant, no cross-workspace surface ...
The app is reachable at the public address read from the environment ...
